title: Error
description: The error object inside a failed result envelope, and the body of a failed provider HTTP call.

code.description: Stable error code; see the errors list.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Do not parse it.

retryable.description: Whether the same request may succeed later without changes.

detail.description: Code-specific fields, e.g. rule for POLICY_DENIED or payment for PAYMENT_NEEDED.
